source_intro: Because of their frequent repetition they are not given in full, but are referred to under abbreviated designations as follows:
transcription_rules: Join layout divisions; retain English words, case and punctuation. Latin comparison transcription normalizes case, removes stress accents and expands ae ligatures; it is not a diplomatic glyph transcription. Each printed formula is followed by a separately marked response Amen; response not folded into the preceding formula here. These are actual source formulas; nothing supplied.

formulas.full_english: Through Our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
formulas.full_latin: Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.

formulas.full_english: Through the same Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
formulas.full_latin: Per eumdem Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.
formulas.address: Prayer making mention of our Blessed Lord

formulas.short_english: Through . . . in the unity of the same.
formulas.full_english: Through Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
formulas.full_latin: Per Jesum Christum filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate ejusdem Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.
formulas.address: Prayer making mention of the Holy Ghost

formulas.full_english: Who with Thee liveth and reigneth in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
formulas.full_latin: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.
formulas.address: Final clause refers to our Blessed Lord

formulas.full_english: Who livest and reignest, with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
formulas.full_latin: Qui vivis et regnas, cum Deo Patre in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.
formulas.address: Prayer addressed directly to God the Son

scope: The printed rule identifies five abbreviated conclusion families. Historical petitions and address/person must be independently checked. Literal actual source English short cues remain unexpanded; no invented ending or response. Latin/English wording differences outside this printed rule are not authorized.
